tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Read one listing by id as Graunt's API gives it (GET /v1/listings/{id}). To answer a question from a listing or cite it, use fetch.

tools.name: get_agent_commerce_manifest
tools.description: Read the agent commerce manifest for a listing: price, rights, and how to buy it.

tools.name: get_bundle_manifest
tools.description: Read the per-asset bundle inventory: every delivered file with role, format, size and content hash, plus counts that name the population each one counted.

tools.name: meta_capabilities
tools.description: Read /v1/meta/capabilities: what Graunt offers to an agent, in machine-readable form.

tools.name: meta_refinery_support_matrix
tools.description: Read /v1/meta/refinery-support-matrix: the source types Graunt accepts and what the Refinery does with each. Every upload gets deterministic extraction; a model drafts only the listing fields a seller leaves empty.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "match_video_spec" is 1177 chars, far longer than this server's median (184). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: fetch, get_bundle_manifest · Public sink: meta_refinery_support_matrix · Destructive: get_bundle_manifest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: fetch, get_bundle_manifest · Public sink: meta_refinery_support_matrix · Destructive: get_bundle_manifest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
